$comment: #EXP-1730 (one-tree model): a message lives on a SESSION (`messages.session_id`). A session's chat is the messages whose `sessionId` is that session; clients read the row's own `sessionId` and never key through `conversations` (the table goes in phase B; the server keeps `conversation_id` in step until then). keyMessagesBySession(messages) returns the messages that carry a session, each with that `sessionId`, in input order; a message with no session (a legacy dm/channel row) belongs to none. Supersedes message-conversation.json (deleted once every client replays this). Mirrors: TS src/message-session.ts, desktop `domain::message_session`, iOS ExpCore `MessageSession.swift`, Android `domain/MessageSession.kt`.

cases.name: each message keys to its own session, in input order
a message with no session (a legacy dm or channel row) belongs to none
a legacy conversationId on the row is ignored: the session decides
